title: Advances in artificial cells capable of metabolic mimicry: from fundamentals to applications
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2026, 55,2465-2492
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS01330E, Tutorial Review
Yan Jia, Jingjing Zhao, Wenxia Xu, Xiangxiang Zhang, Shubin Li, Xiaojun Han
Metabolic mimicry in artificial cells involves energy generation and anabolic and catabolic metabolism. Integrating these modules endows artificial cells with potentials in biosensing and disease treatments.
